subsystem_matrix.name: Application Lifecycle & Bootstrap
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Native UIApplicationDelegate & UIWindowSceneDelegate lifecycle, coordinator bootstrap, configuration initialization
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: AppCheck attestation provider, remote feature flags initialization, A/B experiment config loading

subsystem_matrix.name: Dependency Management
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Thread-safe service locator pattern matching Waze SRLRegistry behavior

subsystem_matrix.name: Main Map UI & Container
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Main canvas hosting hierarchy, zoom/recenter controls, speedometer overlay with warning states, navigation banner
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Full reporting action sheet, lane guidance HUD, road shield icons, audio volume quick-toggle

subsystem_matrix.name: Map Rendering Architecture
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Spherical Web Mercator camera projection, viewport to NDC transform, polyline quad tessellation into triangle vertices
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Proprietary MercatorTile vector road decoding, multi-layer tile pipeline, label collision engine, terrain/landuse shading

subsystem_matrix.name: GPS & Location Tracking
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: CLLocationManager authorization request, location stream filtering, speed and heading updates, speed threshold calculation
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: C++ Kalman filter integration, dead-reckoning tunnel extrapolation, GPS drift correction against road network

subsystem_matrix.name: Search & Destination
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Bottom sheet search drawer, text filtering, recent searches list, home/work shortcuts
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Google Places / Waze live geocoding API, category search over remote POI database, offline street index queries

subsystem_matrix.name: Routing & Route Alternatives
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Alternative route selection state machine, primary/alternate candidate comparison, route preview drawer
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Remote routing graph path calculation, toll cost computation, live traffic delay calculation

subsystem_matrix.name: Turn-by-Turn Guidance
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Distance to next turn calculation, approaching turn threshold triggers, maneuver step progression
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Audio voice prompt speech synthesizer / sound asset playback, lane guidance arrows, exit number badges

subsystem_matrix.name: Navigation State & Off-Route Engine
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Polyline perpendicular snapping, cross-track error calculation, 35m off-route detection trigger, 25m arrival detection
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Server-side reroute query dispatch, traffic incident recalculation during reroute

subsystem_matrix.name: Traffic & Hazard Reporting
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Hazard alert model, reporting action sheet, proximity alert radar, user thumbs-up / thumbs-down feedback

subsystem_matrix.name: Persistence & Local Storage
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Dynamic Keychain storage using active app bundle ID without hardcoded access-group lock, guest session fallback, UserDefaults preferences
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: CoreData / SQLite local spatial tile cache

subsystem_matrix.name: Authentication & Session
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Authentic welcome UI with Get Started and Start as Guest actions, local guest session token generation
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Google OAuth2 sign-in flow, production Waze phone number authentication, SMS verification

subsystem_matrix.name: Network Protocols & Services
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Protocol abstraction for route calculation, offline synthetic route generator with curved waypoints
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: gRPC client channels, protobuf message serialization, production TLS certificate pinning, live traffic event polling

subsystem_matrix.name: App Extensions & CarPlay
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: CarPlay connection state tracking, guidance update stub
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: CPMapTemplate instantiation, CarPlay dashboard trip estimation, Share Sheet extension, Push notification actions

subsystem_matrix.name: Settings, Restrictions & Preferences
subsystem_matrix.implemented_behavior: Preferences storage for avoidTolls, avoidHighways, avoidUnpavedRoads, speedUnits, voicePromptsEnabled
subsystem_matrix.missing_behavior: Dedicated settings navigation UI, Hoy No Circula license plate dialog, vehicle type picker (Taxi, Motorcycle, EV)
